c1_segment_length.note: Length of the PA12 edge-guard fit coupon.

c1_edge_height.note: Small aluminum edge-strip height; fixture geometry only.

c1_split_pair_length.note: Total length of the two-piece split-end coupon.

c1_mark_size.note: Raised PA12 coupon ID text height; verify legibility on a physical print.

c1_mark_rise.note: Raised PA12 coupon ID height; physical readability remains untested.

c1_fit_clearance_variants.note: Change fit clearance only from the guard candidate baseline.

c1_adhesive_layer_variants.note: Change adhesive layer only from the guard candidate baseline.

c1_thickness_variants.note: Compare the 1.0 mm guard against the adopted 1.2 mm candidate.

c3_plate_width.note: Coupon span across the bracket; centered at the source hole.

c3_plate_reach.note: Coupon reach inward from the actual joint edge.

c3_joint_id.note: Use the candidate's real front-bottom bracket hole records on both faces.

c3_slot_length_variants.note: Compare a longer slot while preserving the candidate slot width.

c3_round_reference_diameter.note: Fixed round-hole reference diameter for the C3 comparison.

c3_include_round_reference.note: Include a phi 5.5 mm round-hole control at the same two-face centers.
